news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
The latest committed raw feed was fresh at review time and the Thursday PSX session was live under the repository calendar. EXCHANGE_HOLIDAYS is empty and SESSION_OVERRIDES is empty.

The refinery-upgrade story advances the timing of an already approved brownfield-refinery programme: officials confirmed a signing ceremony scheduled for 11:00 PKT on September 24. At this review time the signing had not yet occurred, so completion is not claimed and no score-bearing Refinery sector rating is added.
The accessible The News and Profit reports show the publication date as September 24, 2026 but do not expose a reliable exact publication clock time. No timestamp was invented.

A Mettis oil headline states that oil is falling for a fifth straight session, but its raw timestamp is later than the raw file's own fetch time and the linked page body is inaccessible. It conflicts with page-verified current-session reports showing a 3.86% Brent rebound on Wednesday followed by a modest Thursday pullback, so that headline-only item remains non-score-bearing.

K-Electric's regulatory outcome may still be challenged in a higher legal forum, so the current negative assessment reflects the presently notified tariff and tribunal outcome rather than assuming litigation is finished.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan schedules $6bn brownfield refinery upgrade agreements for 11am
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to tracked Refinery names ATRL, NRL, PRL and CNERGY; PARCO is also part of the five-refinery programme but is not a tracked listed symbol.
reviewed_stories.reason: This continues the already notified brownfield-refinery policy and earlier refinery readiness. The materially new fact is that government and industry officials confirmed the upgrade agreements were scheduled for formal signing at 11:00 PKT on September 24. Moving from a general October 1 deadline to a same-day signing schedule is a positive implementation milestone for the participating refineries, but the ceremony had not yet occurred at review time, so completion is not claimed.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified as published September 24, 2026. The accessible pages do not display a reliable exact publication clock time, so no time is invented.

reviewed_stories.title: K-Electric base tariff cut upheld and notified
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct KEL tariff and allowed-return economics.
reviewed_stories.reason: NEPRA notified K-Electric's FY24-FY30 base tariff at Rs32.37 per unit, 19% below the original Rs39.97 determination. Dawn reports the effective return falling to about 13-14% from 22-23%, and KE itself says the outcome has a substantial adverse impact and is financially unsustainable. Further legal remedies remain possible.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Dawn; the linked report was published September 24, 2026 at 07:04 PKT and later updated.

reviewed_stories.title: Nishat Mills signs 20MW solar and 35MWh battery project
reviewed_stories.reason: NML signed for a 20MW solar plant and 35MWh BESS at its Bekhi and Ferozwatwan plants, with generation expected in March 2027. The project should reduce exposure to purchased peak power and improve energy reliability, but the article does not disclose capex or quantified savings.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Mettis Global at September 23, 2026 03:30 PM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: D.G. Khan Cement signs 25MW solar and 10MWh battery project
reviewed_stories.reason: DGKC signed for a 25MW solar plant and 10MWh BESS at its Dera Ghazi Khan cement plant, with generation expected in March 2027. The project has a plausible direct cost and reliability benefit, but capex and expected savings were not disclosed.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Mettis Global at September 23, 2026 03:57 PM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: Nishat Mills shareholders approve Rs2.048bn dairy-stake sale
reviewed_stories.reason: Shareholders approved sale of NML's 49.10% Nishat Sutas Dairy stake for Rs2.048bn, subject to regulatory approvals. The article does not provide carrying value, disposal gain or loss, or intended use of proceeds, so the directional earnings impact cannot be established.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified on Mettis Global at September 23, 2026 04:01 PM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: Oil falls for fifth straight session as U.S.-Iran talks ease supply fears
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Headline implies a negative crude-price link to Oil & Gas Exploration, but evidence quality is insufficient for a current-session rating.
reviewed_stories.reason: The newly fetched Mettis headline implies falling crude, but its raw timestamp is later than the raw file's own fetch time and the article body was inaccessible. It also conflicts with page-verified current reports showing Brent settled Wednesday up 3.86% at $103.08 and traded at $102.13 early Thursday. It is therefore headline-only and non-score-bearing.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Unverified. The raw feed records 2026-09-24T09:36:29+00:00, which is later than the raw file fetch time. The linked page was inaccessible, so no corrected publication timestamp is invented.

reviewed_stories.title: Brent rebounds above $100 before easing to $102.13
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to tracked Oil & Gas Exploration producers OGDC, PPL and MARI.
reviewed_stories.reason: Brent settled Wednesday at $103.08, up 3.86%, then eased to $102.13 early Thursday. That materially reverses the prior sub-$100 crude move and restores a near-term price tailwind for upstream producers, though diplomacy and inventory news keep the signal volatile.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Page-verified Business Recorder update at September 24, 2026 08:02 PKT; the prior settlement article was published at 05:47 PKT.

reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector link to Oil Marketing, including PSO.
